tips.intro: One drawer for the passwords, API keys and tokens your setup needs. Nothing here is handed to the model on its own — a value is read only at the moment something that needs it runs.
tips.scenario1Body: The install wizard asks for whatever that plugin needs. Anything you skip stays marked “needs setup”, so you can come back and fill it in later.
tips.scenario2Body: Instead of pasting a key into the connection itself, you point at a secret by name. The real value stays here, and you can replace it later without touching the connection.
tips.scenario3Body: If a task needs a service that requires signing in, the assistant reads the secret while it runs — for example to look something up or send a request.
tips.scopeUser: This page (account level): shared by all your workspaces. Best for a key you use everywhere.
tips.scopeWorkspace: A workspace’s own Secrets tab: visible only inside that workspace. Best for a key that belongs to one client or one project.
tips.scopeOverride: If the same name exists in both, the workspace’s value wins — and only there.
tips.safetyMasked: Saved values are masked; use Reveal when you need to read one back.
tips.safetyUninstall: Removing a plugin never deletes keys you entered.
tips.safetyStudents: Student accounts in a family plan cannot open this page.
tips.footer: Not sure where to start? Add one of the recommended credentials below.
